titulo: 5 Bugs You Should NEVER Kill Around Your House (And 1 You Should)
titulos_alternativos: Never Kill These 5 Bugs in Your House (Number One Hunts Black Widows)
5 Creepy Bugs That Are Secretly Working for You (And 1 That Isn't)
descripcion:
You are pouring your morning coffee when something small moves on the window sill, turns around, and looks straight at you. Your hand is already reaching for a paper towel. Wait.

Most of the small, creepy things that show up in your house are not invaders. They are roommates, and they work for free. Here are five bugs you should never kill, and one that you really should.
